say:1:1033721001:1.text: Please... Let me catch my breath first...
say:1:1033721001:1.source_cn: 呼……呼……麻烦，先让我喘口气……
say:1:1033721001:1.male: Please... Let me catch my breath first...
say:1:1033721001:1.female: Please... Let me catch my breath first...

say:2:1033721002:1.text: Whew... When the corruption became too intense, our archaeology professor called off our project out of concern for everyone's safety.
say:2:1033721002:1.source_cn: 呼……之前腐化严重的时候，研究遗址的老师担心我们会遇到...
say:2:1033721002:1.male: Whew... When the corruption became too intense, our archaeology professor called off our project out of concern for everyone's safety.
say:2:1033721002:1.female: Whew... When the corruption became too intense, our archaeology professor called off our project out of concern for everyone's safety.

say:3:1033721003:1.text: We were told to wait in the Vaduso Mountains and to stay out of the Dark Forest at all costs. Our professor looked so sad and listless during those days...
say:3:1033721003:1.source_cn: 那段时间的他每天都有气无力……
say:3:1033721003:1.male: We were told to wait in the Vaduso Mountains and to stay out of the Dark Forest at all costs. Our professor looked so sad and listless during those days...
say:3:1033721003:1.female: We were told to wait in the Vaduso Mountains and to stay out of the Dark Forest at all costs. Our professor looked so sad and listless during those days...

say:4:1033721004:1.text: But just look at him now! I can barely keep up with him!
say:4:1033721004:1.source_cn: 但看看现在的老师！他赶路的精神比我还好！
say:4:1033721004:1.male: But just look at him now! I can barely keep up with him!
say:4:1033721004:1.female: But just look at him now! I can barely keep up with him!

say:5:1033721005:1.text: He's so excited to get to Rainford. Apparently there are some nearby ruins, and the professor believes they are closely related to Misarte.
say:5:1033721005:1.source_cn: 我们要去附近的沐霖村，向那里的村民询问散落在附近的遗迹...
say:5:1033721005:1.male: He's so excited to get to Rainford. Apparently there are some nearby ruins, and the professor believes they are closely related to Misarte.
say:5:1033721005:1.female: He's so excited to get to Rainford. Apparently there are some nearby ruins, and the professor believes they are closely related to Misarte.
